methodology.directional: bullish/bearish matrix_direction uses future benchmark excess return; bearish signs are inverted so positive directional_excess means the matrix direction was correct.
methodology.neutral: neutral/conflict states receive no synthetic win rate; future absolute excess dispersion is measured instead.
methodology.deduplication: append-only audit records are retained, but evaluation uses the latest methodology revision for an identical asset/date/semantic-state tuple.
methodology.minimum_readout: win-rate readout remains insufficient_sample until at least 8 directional settled observations exist in a group.

boundary: Historical validation only; these statistics are not converted into future probabilities or automatic trading actions.
